ai-dev-release-helper v1.0.0

- Initial release: Automates the entire GitHub project publishing workflow for developers.
- Features include: competitor research, AI-generated project cover/feature images, and generation of a 3,000–5,000 word WeChat analysis article.
- Supports streamlined input parameters (project, tagline, GitHub link) for one-command execution.
- Integrates brave-search for market research, nano-banana-pro for images, and wechat-article-pro for article generation.
- Outputs cover image, feature image, competitor analysis, and WeChat-ready markdown article.
